intent_snapshot.goal: Meet S7 of docs/specs/drive-always-lanes.spec.md: retire in-place Enrollment by deleting the Claude Code enroll MCP tool and the Pi imm_canary_enrollment tool with their native-gate code, run-entry admission and contract text, move tests that used them as setup onto Kernel-level enrollment helpers, and keep TaskRecords enrolled in place before this change resumable until terminal as a drain-only path (owner: runtime) (Spec D10, D12; Retirement Completion Contract).

acceptance.assertion: The Claude Code MCP tool list contains no enroll tool and the Pi package registers no imm_canary_enrollment tool: plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-canary-enroll.ts is deleted and removed from .pi-extension/package.json, the enroll handler and its gate in runtime/claude are deleted, and runtime/assurance/phase_entry.ts admits only start_unattended_batch and retire_stale_batch as entry tools. A TaskRecord enrolled in place before this change still advances through the loop tools to terminal on both Hosts. Seam: the named tool-surface and package tests plus a drain fixture.

No file under plugins/immune-brain/dist, plugins/immune-brain/runtime/prompts, plugins/immune-brain/BASELINE.md or CONTEXT.md instructs in-place Enrollment or current-context Executor execution outside a Lane, which tests/unattended-contracts.test.ts asserts; tests that used the Host enroll tools as setup enroll through Kernel-level helpers instead, and the named focused tests pass. The full-suite check of BR-REQ-7 is the batch final_verification (Spec D12).

advisory_findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/BASELINE.md is unchanged by S7. Its paragraphs near lines 128-134 still describe a current-Host Enrollment confirmation, the Host creating the unborn-HEAD root commit, and a workspace_not_clean refusal before the gate opens. These match the retired in-place enroll handler, and the unattended-contracts regex does not cover them. The text is ambiguous rather than an explicit in-place instruction, since a Lane entry also has one native gate, so it is non-blocking. Reword it to Lane Enrollment in a follow-up.
